exercises.q: When was the bridge started?
exercises.text: The Charles Bridge in Prague, which connects the Old Town with the Lesser Town, was built in the 14th century. It was started in 1357 during the reign of Charles IV, who gave the bridge its later name. For centuries it was the only way across the river. The statues which line the bridge were added much later, mostly around 1700. Today the original statues are kept in a museum and the ones that visitors see are copies. The bridge is crossed by thousands of tourists every day, which is why many locals avoid it.

exercises.q: What will happen in June?
exercises.text: Hi everyone! Our apartment block is being renovated this summer. The windows will be replaced in June and the lifts will be repaired in July. While the work is being done, the main entrance will be closed and residents who live on floors 1–4 should use the side door. Parcels that are delivered during this period will be left at the caretaker's office. If you have any questions, please contact Mr Novák, whose number is on the notice board.
